description.value: The Flamingo Motel is a mid-range motel on Skaha Lake Road in Penticton, offering air-conditioned rooms equipped with cable TV, microwave, and refrigerator, with select rooms featuring kitchenettes. An on-site picnic area with BBQ facilities provides a convenient spot to prepare food at the end of a ride. The property sits within easy walking distance of Cherry Lane Mall and is well-positioned for exploring the Skaha Lake corridor and South Okanagan wine routes.

address.value: 2387 Skaha Lake Road, Penticton, BC V2A 6E8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names this 'Flaming Motel' but the discovered website and all page content consistently use 'Flamingo Motel', indicating a name error in OSM. Critically, the website at flamingomotelpenticton.site is an independent third-party booking aggregator that explicitly states 'We are not the official website nor affiliated with the property,' so its data is useful for general amenity cross-checking but cannot confirm official contact details. Wi-Fi is doubly confirmed (OSM internet_access=wlan and website policies page state 'WiFi is available in all hotel rooms'); no bike-specific facilities (secure storage, tools, wash) are mentioned anywhere in the aggregator content.
concerns: OSM name is 'Flaming Motel' but the actual business name appears to be 'Flamingo Motel' — likely a typo in OSM that should be corrected.

The discovered URL (flamingomotelpenticton.site) leads to an independent third-party booking aggregator that explicitly disclaims any affiliation with Flamingo Motel; no official motel website was found.
Because the website is a third-party aggregator, the OSM phone number (+1-250-492-8333) could not be corroborated and amenity details may not be authoritative.
